source: Dış kaynaklarda saptanan eksik soru tipleri; bağımsız anlatım ve resmî cevap kontrolü (2026-10-13)
answer_convention: İki dilde aynı sırada; ilk şık doğru. Belirsiz cevap aktif bankada yok.
id_convention: Kalıcı idler_090.json; eski veya emekli kimlik yeniden kullanılmaz.

questions.text: In the UK CAP 413 procedure, an aeroplane turns onto final 8 NM from touchdown. Which circuit position report applies at that point?
options: FINAL at any distance with no distinction.

questions.text: Under SERA, which traffic is included in aerodrome traffic?
options: All traffic on the manoeuvring area and aircraft flying in the aerodrome vicinity.
Only aircraft actually landing or taking off.
All aircraft anywhere in the flight information region.

questions.text: During interception, the common-language procedure cannot be used and the intercepting aircraft transmits FOLLOW. What does it mean?
In standard radiotelephony, what does an instruction to ACKNOWLEDGE request?
options: Confirm that the message was received and understood.

questions.text: A radio check returns READABILITY ONE. How intelligible is the transmission?
ATIS is unavailable. Which standard request asks for the aerodrome data needed before departure?
ATC uses RECLEARED while issuing a revised route. What is the relationship between the new and previous clearance?
options: The new clearance replaces the changed part of the previous clearance.
Both routes remain available at the pilot’s choice.
The flight plan has automatically been cancelled.
The aircraft is authorised to take off without a separate clearance.

questions.text: Under the current SERA channel-identification rule, how is VHF channel 118.150 transmitted?
options: ONE ONE EIGHT DECIMAL ONE FIVE ZERO.
ONE ONE EIGHT DECIMAL ONE FIVE.
ONE ONE EIGHT POINT ONE FIVE ZERO.
ONE HUNDRED EIGHTEEN DECIMAL ONE FIFTY.

questions.text: What does IMC identify, as distinct from IFR?
options: Instrument meteorological conditions, with weather below the specified VMC minima.
Instrument flight rules, regardless of the actual weather.
A clearance to operate special VFR.
Visual meteorological conditions meeting the specified minima.

questions.text: At a controlled aerodrome, what standard request asks ATC for taxi instructions before departure?
options: REQUEST TAXI, followed by the relevant flight details.
READY FOR TAKE-OFF, which also authorises taxi.
REQUEST BACKTRACK, regardless of the route required.
LINE UP, without first obtaining taxi instructions.

questions.text: Which standard ATC expression tells a pilot that specified position reports are no longer required?
options: OMIT POSITION REPORTS, with any stated limit.

questions.text: Which pair uses standard SERA level-change instructions for a climb and a descent, respectively?
options: CLIMB TO FLIGHT LEVEL EIGHT ZERO; DESCEND TO FLIGHT LEVEL SIX ZERO.
EXPECT FLIGHT LEVEL EIGHT ZERO; REPORT FLIGHT LEVEL SIX ZERO.

questions.text: An aircraft is climbing under a clearance to FL 100. ATC needs it to stop climbing at FL 80. Which standard instruction expresses this change?
options: STOP CLIMB AT FLIGHT LEVEL EIGHT ZERO.
CONTINUE CLIMB TO FLIGHT LEVEL ONE ZERO ZERO.
REPORT LEAVING FLIGHT LEVEL EIGHT ZERO.
EXPECT CLIMB AT FLIGHT LEVEL EIGHT ZERO.

questions.text: After landing, the tower requests a report when the runway is vacated. When is RUNWAY VACATED accurate?
options: Once the entire aircraft is beyond the applicable runway holding-position marking.
As soon as the nose passes the runway edge.
When only the cockpit crosses the holding-position marking.
As soon as the aircraft starts turning into a taxiway.

questions.text: Under the UK CAP 413 towered-circuit reporting procedure, when is a BASE report required?
options: When required by the ATS provider or aerodrome operator.
On every flight worldwide regardless of local procedures.
Never; only FINAL may be reported.

questions.text: The diagram shows a left-hand circuit with landing towards the right. What are the legs marked E,F,G, respectively?
Which aerodrome area is designated for loading or unloading passengers or cargo, fuelling, parking or maintenance?
ATC instructs a pilot to LINE UP AND WAIT on the specified runway. What is authorised?
options: Enter the runway and wait in the take-off position; take-off needs a further clearance.
Enter the runway and immediately commence take-off.
Taxi beyond the runway without stopping.
Remain at the holding point and never enter the runway.

questions.text: ATC asks CONFIRM EIGHT POINT THREE THREE. Your radio is capable of 8.33 kHz channel spacing. Which reply states that capability?
options: AFFIRM EIGHT POINT THREE THREE, followed by the aircraft call sign.
NEGATIVE EIGHT POINT THREE THREE, followed by the call sign.
AFFIRM EIGHT POINT THREE THREE EXEMPTED, regardless of exemption status.

questions.text: A pilot has no transponder installed and ATC requests transponder capability. Which standard reply is appropriate?
During interception, the common-language procedure cannot be used and the intercepting aircraft transmits PROCEED. What does it mean?
During interception, the common-language procedure cannot be used and the intercepting aircraft transmits CALL SIGN. What does it mean?
options: What is your aircraft call sign?

questions.text: During interception, the common-language procedure cannot be used and the intercepting aircraft transmits YOU LAND. What does it mean?
During interception without a common language, which prescribed phrase reports inability to comply with an instruction?
During interception without a common language, which phrase tells the intercepting pilot that your position is unknown to you?
